lots.addr: Yew Tree Farm House, Great North Road, Gamston, Retford, Nottinghamshire DN22 0PZ
lots.blurb: A substantial detached property of approx. 3,213 Sq Ft which could suit a variety of different residential uses for both owner occupier / extended family, or investment as a HMO as the property has previously been used as C2/C3 Supported / assisted living. The property is in good order throughout and ready for occupation and is currently arranged as 8 bedrooms primarily on the first floor, 4 of which being en-suite along with communal bathroom and multiple living spaces on the ground floor which could also provide additional bedroom spaces if required. Outside, the property has good size grounds providing garden space and ample off street parking to both the front, side and rear.

Outside there are gardens to both the front and rear as well as adjacent communal parking.

lots.blurb: A four room HMO which is currently fully let producing £17,680 per annum located on Park Road within the city centre. The property has gas central heating, double glazing and it is worth noting that all rooms have their own separate metered utilities. The property comprises a communal Entrance Hall, Room One, Room Two, Communal Kitchen and Bathroom on the ground floor, To the first floor are two further Rooms. Outside, there is a small front garden at the front with an enclosed rear garden and detached garage / store.

lots.addr: The White Rose, Grange Lane, New Rossington, Doncaster, South Yorkshire DN11 0QZ
lots.blurb: The former White Rose public house, occupying a prominent position in the New Rossington area to the south east Doncaster and well placed for the motorway network which gives easy access to a number of regional centres. The property occupies a freehold site of 0.33 ha (0.82 acre) which gives considerable potential for redevelopment, subject to the necessary planning consents. lots.blurb: A large four bedroom, two / three reception room bay windowed end of terrace property requiring general modernisation and refurbishment. lots.blurb: A three bedroom terrace property located in Messingham, a sought after village on the outskirts of Scunthorpe. The accommodation benefits from gas central heating, double glazing and requires some general modernisation. The property comprises a lounge, kitchen, three bedrooms and a bathroom. Outside there is a rear garden. The property has a small local High Street within walking distance with a range of shops, coffee shops, pubs and bars.

lots.addr: 6, 7 & 7a Main Street and Rose Cottage, Main Street, Harworth, Doncaster, South Yorkshire DN11 8LB
lots.blurb: SUBSTANTIAL MIXED INVESTMENT - £21,000pa . A high profile brick built property located in the heart of this popular area to the south of Doncaster, well served by the motorway network, enabling access to a number of regional centres. The property comprises two ground floor commercial units, a single and a double (6 & 7 Main Street) together with a spacious first floor apartment ( 7a) and a separate residential property to the rear (Rose Cottage). All four are let, producing £1,750 pcm with an overall annual income of £21,000.
